title: Client limit file (Finspot OMS)
purpose: Trading limit per client before the market opens, and limit changes during the day. Finspot's RMS limit upload has 54 columns, all listed here; the file SharePro sends Finspot daily stops after the first five (account, exchange, segment, product, collateral/margin value), so Ledgerline writes those five and the line ends there (trailing_empty: a line may stop before the columns Ledgerline does not fill, typed blank here, so SharePro's 5-field files read with no issues). A blank exchange, segment or product means across all of them. The account ID is the UCC (10 characters at most).
